method.scope: block NAME SET only; numeric ids are deliberately not paired. Ids are what the previous rejected artifact got wrong, so they are not inferred here.
method.identifyRegistry: STRUCTURAL, no name is used to find the class: the class whose static initialiser constructs the most distinct classes via the new/dup/invokespecial <init> pattern. Ranking by distinct constructed classes is what separates the block registry from the item registry, which constructs a few classes many times each.
method.nameConventionNote: Block names are attached by a chained `(String) -> <registry type>` setter called once per block (the post-Beta-1.9 mechanism). Each name is the string constant loaded immediately before the setter call. For Release 1.6.4 two setter families exist: `setName` carries the post-flattening registered name (e.g. `gold_ore`) and `setIconName` carries the pre-flattening legacy name (e.g. `oreGold`). Both are recorded here; the union is the set of names this client registers.
method.structuralBlockClassIdentityEvidence: aqz has 65 direct subclasses in this jar; a block class is the class block variants extend (Beta 1.7.3's equivalent is uu with 49).
